name: mirror_tie
provenance: Adversarial fixture A1 (docs/ASCENSION_TRIALS_KIRO_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_V1_1.md §14 A1 'Mirror tie': 'Identical states and allocations. Expected: identical RP, final shared result and player-swap symmetry'; MATH-1). Two players with identical Void-5 states each allocate Void 5 to a single mono-source Purity Trial worth 6. The resolver must award both the shared-full reward (6 each), report a shared final result with win/margin utility 0, and be invariant under swapping the two player labels (identical SHA-256 audit hash, REQ-7.3). Config, states, allocations and expected outcomes transcribed from source, not reverse-engineered from engine output (REQ-9.4).

player_swap_symmetry.note: The two players are identical, so relabelling A<->B leaves the normalized inputs unchanged and the resolver returns the identical SHA-256 audit hash (REQ-7.3).
